name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's motorsport obsession began early, fueled by watching her father, a rally mechanic, tinker with engines. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. Before joining Manthey Racing, Klara spent several years with a smaller GT team, honing her skills in data analysis and simulation. She's known for her meticulous approach to problem-solving and her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for drivers. 

Her demanding nature stems from a deep-seated desire for perfection and a belief in pushing boundaries. While some find her direct communication style challenging, Klara is a staunch advocate for her team and genuinely committed to their success. She believes in continuous improvement and constantly seeks innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. Her experience has made her a valuable mentor, and she takes pride in guiding junior engineers.

physical.hairStyle: Straight, shoulder-length hair, usually pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Klara has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Insists on using a specific brand of pen for all official documents.
Has a habit of tapping her foot rapidly when deep in thought.
